A1.justification: Both complete 20-page PDFs describe PoseMaster and include the same supplementary Sections 9–11. Text, equations, tables and figures support reliable comparison. Pages 2–20 render identically; first-page differences are confined to the arXiv margin stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original quantitative pose-generation evaluations in Tables 1–4, inference timings in Table 5, and qualitative ablation, robustness and generalization results.

after.justification: v4 retains these original quantitative evaluations, inference timings and qualitative experiments, including the supplementary results.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 retain the identical data engine, dense skeleton representation, skeleton encoder and image/skeleton-conditioned diffusion model. The training objectives and inference formulation are unchanged.

E1.justification: Training sources and evaluation coverage match, including VRoid canonicalization, arbitrary-pose stylization, DeepFashion images, AI-generated images, CharacterGen’s test set and mismatched-skeleton scenarios in the supplement.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within every experiment: CharacterGen, StdGen, Trellis, CraftsMan and Hunyuan3D 2.1 in Table 1; the same three native generators in Tables 2–4; and unchanged timing and supplementary comparisons.

E3.justification: Both retain the 50-image VRoid evaluation, identical baseline input conditions, MAE/SIM and Uni3D-I/ULIP-I metrics, and the 36-azimuth matching procedure in Section 9.1. Training and timing settings also match.

E4.justification: The pose-representation and skeleton-guidance ablations in Section 5.3 are identical. Supplementary efficiency, mismatched-skeleton robustness, texture-generation and application analyses are also retained without revision.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates without repeated-run counts, random-seed information, error bars, confidence intervals or significance tests. No statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–5 and all qualitative results match. For example, PoseMaster’s MAE remains 4.59 in Table 1 and 5.28 in Table 2; its reported inference time remains approximately 23.48 seconds.

T1.justification: Equations 1–4, including the flow-matching objectives, skeleton-feature construction and guidance formulation, are identical. No mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about unified native 3D pose generation, explicit skeleton control, scalable triplet construction, superior performance and animatable-asset creation.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning cascade errors and explicit 3D structural guidance are unchanged. Section 11 retains the same limitations concerning hand gestures, skirts, hairstyles and geometric detail at resolution 512.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility disclosures match, including pretrained components, frozen modules, learning rate, feature dimensions, augmentation, data rendering and NVIDIA H20 timing hardware. No code or data access information changes.

R1.justification: The same 78 references and related-work discussion appear in both PDFs. Positioning against cascaded pose-stylization pipelines, native 3D generators and autoregressive rigging methods is unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2, dated 20 March 2026, to v4, dated 30 July 2026. PDF author metadata also changes, while the printed author list, prose, terminology and section structure remain identical.

P2.justification: The first-page arXiv margin stamp moves rightward and downward. All 19 figures, five tables, captions and manuscript layouts, including the supplementary image grids, otherwise remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The complete scientific content is unchanged, including the method, experimental evidence, supplementary analyses and limitations. Changes to publication markings, metadata and margin-stamp placement do not meaningfully affect the paper’s clarity, evidential support or overall quality.
